title: MacBook built-in keyboard (JIS) as an HHKB, for JIS Korean

rules.description: MacBook (JIS) as HHKB: Caps Lock is カタカナ on a tap and the HHKB Fn layer on a hold, with ⌘⇧4 on I and Play/Pause on P [required]

manipulators.description: Caps Lock: tap カタカナ (to Korean), hold the Fn layer
Fn+F1: F1 with fn, as 🌐+F1 does
Fn+F2: F2 with fn, as 🌐+F2 does
Fn+F3: F3 with fn, as 🌐+F3 does
Fn+F4: F4 with fn, as 🌐+F4 does
Fn+F5: F5 with fn, as 🌐+F5 does
Fn+F6: F6 with fn, as 🌐+F6 does
Fn+F7: F7 with fn, as 🌐+F7 does
Fn+F8: F8 with fn, as 🌐+F8 does
Fn+F9: F9 with fn, as 🌐+F9 does
Fn+F10: F10 with fn, as 🌐+F10 does
Fn+F11: F11 with fn, as 🌐+F11 does
Fn+F12: F12 with fn, as 🌐+F12 does
Fn+↑: Page Up, as macOS does
Fn+↓: Page Down, as macOS does

rules.description: MacBook (JIS) as HHKB: 🌐 reaches the same Fn layer, for the keys it defines; other 🌐 chords as usual [🌐]
